bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: errorMessage should be error
Failed to trigger price update (generic message shown instead of real error)
bugs.root_cause: Field name mismatch: backend sent errorMessage, frontend read progress.error (undefined). Also route sent redundant {status:complete} after scheduler already sent {status:completed}, falling to default case.
bugs.fix: Renamed errorMessage->error in all onProgress calls in scheduler.ts and prices.ts sendProgress type. Removed redundant sendProgress({status:complete}) in prices.ts.

bugs.root_cause: Code path had no error handling — exceptions would propagate uncaught

bugs.error_message: Phantom prices: B076X71VMB (marketplace-only) showed 'R$ 16.90' belonging to no real offer; unavailable products displayed a price
bugs.root_cause: Price fallback Methods 3 & 4 searched the ENTIRE document (document.querySelectorAll('span.a-price-whole') / page.textContent('.a-price .a-offscreen')). When the main buy-box price was absent (marketplace-only, unavailable, unknown layout) they grabbed the first visible price anywhere — typically a recommendation carousel card (li.a-carousel-card / idAsinFaceoutContainer), e.g. R$16,90. Confirmed live via Playwright MCP.
bugs.fix: Replaced Methods 3 & 4 with a single scoped fallback searching only an allowlist of main-price containers (.a-price.priceToPay, #corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div, #corePrice_feature_div, #apex_offerDisplay_desktop, #buybox, #price, #priceblock_*), rejecting candidates whose ancestor matches a carousel/sponsored/similar-items selector and skipping strikethrough list prices. If no main-region price is found, returns price:null + available:false + reason 'Preço não disponível' instead of a stray number. Verified: B076X71VMB->null(unavailable), B076KZYYRJ->16,90, B08T6MCKMK->53,36.
